name: Buyer Representation Agreement
description: The agreement a home buyer signs with a real estate broker before touring homes. The checks read for compensation stated as a specific amount or rate and not left open-ended, a statement that the broker may not receive more than that, a statement that compensation is not set by law and is fully negotiable, an end date, whether the agreement is exclusive, and the services the broker will provide. Distinct from `listing-agreement`, which the seller signs.
compliance_matrix_columns: Compensation as a specific amount or rate
Broker may not receive more than the agreed amount
Statement that compensation is not set by law and is fully negotiable
The services the broker will provide
